text:
incidents-bot: Pager: inference-prod cluster (eu-west-1a) high error-rate + latency spike. Alert: net_egress_jitter. 5xx up ~12% over baseline. Link: <https://ops.redwood/alerts/3289990001>

emily: noticing gRPC resets and long tail. p50 fine, p95 ~3s, some requests 10s then reset. Customers A/B seeing timeouts. Working on quick impact numbers.

raj: host EC2 metrics show TX packet drops on ENI, and NAT gateway 502 spikes around same time. No recent deploys in the cluster.

sre-oncall: I'm oncall for this pager. Starting runbook: single-AZ-network-degradation. Steps: 1) assess scope 2) shift traffic 3) drain affected pods 4) engage cloud support if needed.

netops: DNS resolver RTTs in eu-west-1a are spiking ~200-500ms; resolver error rate ~15%. This will amplify connection setup for GRPC streams. Suspect resolver backend/route flapping.

emily: quick check: `curl -svS https://inference-redwood-eu-west-1a/health` returns intermittent 502s and: 
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
x-request-id: 5f9b3a
connection: close
```

raj: added vpcflow logs snippet, showing ENI TX resets (`ERR_TX_RESET`) around 12:34Z.

infra-bot: Auto-suggest: recommend shifting 60% traffic to eu-west-1b (same region), hold 40% for validation. Use `trafficctl shift` with gradual ramp.

sre-oncall: doing that now. `trafficctl shift --from eu-west-1a --to eu-west-1b --percent 60 --ramp 5m`

emily: copy. Watch for K/V cache cold-start errors — model cache miss rate increased when we previously shifted. Suggest pin small fraction (5%) to a warm path to prime caches.

raj: rolling the shift. Observability: routing change in progress. Graphs show error-rate starting to decline after 90s, but p95 still high.

netops: I've enabled cross-AZ DNS fallback on resolver pool and bumped resolver retries to 3. That reduced handshake failures on some nodes.

emily: customers affected: ~8% of active sessions experienced 502/timeout during the 12:30-12:45 window. Primary impact: interactive features with low retry. Logged customer IDs for follow up.

sre-oncall: deciding on next step: 1) continue ramp to 90% to eu-west-1b, 2) drain problematic nodes in eu-west-1a, 3) open cloud ticket for ENI/NAT backend. Any objections?

raj: +1 to all. For draining, do `node-drain --group eu-west-1a-inference --grace 60` and ensure KV cache priming path (emily's idea) is kept.

emily: starting KV prime job: `prime-cache --model=server-gnn-13b --nodes=eu-west-1b --ratio=0.05`

infra-bot: Reminder: rolling >80% traffic across AZs may surface capacity limits. Monitoring reserved capacity metrics.

sre-oncall: ramping to 90% now. `trafficctl shift --from eu-west-1a --to eu-west-1b --percent 90 --ramp 10m`

(2m later)

raj: error-rate continues down to ~3%, p95 at 650ms. Some residual errors tied to a subset of nodes that lost routes.

netops: cloud provider acknowledged an elevated ENI error rate in eu-west-1a, filing internal incident. They see NAT gateway backend retries correlating with our window.

emily: started draining 6 nodes that flagged TX resets. Drained with `kubectl drain` + `trafficctl exclude-node`. Cache misses tracked and primed.

cleo: taking handoff in 30m for next shift. I’ll watch the dashboards and customer DMs.

sre-oncall: opening post-incident channel and logging action items. Short-term: keep traffic shifted until cloud stabilizes. Medium-term: add automatic multi-AZ resolver fallback within runtime and improve early-warning for ENI resets.

emily: Customer comms draft: "We've identified a partial network impairment in eu-west-1a causing elevated timeouts for inference calls. Traffic has been shifted and services are stable. We're monitoring and working with the cloud provider. Apologies for the disruption." Thoughts?

raj: LGTM. Add timeframe and affected customers count.

netops: also add that DNS fallback was enabled and KV cache priming reduced retries.

incidents-bot: Summary created: <https://ops.redwood/incidents/3289990001/summary> — includes timeline, metrics, and mitigation steps.

cleo: taking over as oncall for follow-up. @sre-oncall handing off live. :raised_hands: 

sre-oncall: handoff complete. Key actions left: 1) keep traffic off eu-west-1a until provider clears ENI errors, 2) cloud ticket priority P2 -> escalate if not resolved in 2 hours, 3) schedule postmortem with netops + infra tomorrow.

emily: adding action item: implement small-runbook tweak to auto-prime caches when cross-AZ shift >30%.

raj: saved logs and pcaps to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incident/3289990001/pcap.tar.gz

cleo: noted. I'll own follow-up and customer updates. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: closing pager for now as overall SLOs recovered. Will remain available for the postmortem.

(End of thread)
